_comment: Hook Configuration Examples for Claude Code Enterprise
_usage: Copy the relevant hook sections into your .claude/settings.json

test_on_save._description: Run tests automatically after every file edit

lint_before_commit._description: Run linter before any git commit

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

desktop_notification._description: macOS notification when Claude finishes or needs input

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

block_dangerous_commands._description: Block specific dangerous commands at the hook level

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM.*WHERE 1'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive database operation detected' >&2; exit 1; fi
